evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep asks 'Are you asked for the meeting ID?' and customer is Jaquelin Hall-AB; name used multiple times throughout walkthrough.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No quid pro quo framing present; rep jumps directly into walkthrough logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moves straight to 'our goal is to keep remove as easy as possible. Please let us know what are the things that we are moving.'
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: No On-Time Guarantee or No Worries Damage Coverage mentioned at any point in the call.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Rep asks about boxes: 'based on your home size normally, the total number of boxes is between 95 to 115 boxes.' Customer responds about packing: 'everything in boxes, yeah, I close it will be like a pretty much boxes.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides: 'estimated time is between five to six hours...total estimate that we have is $2,328' and later 'four movers and two trucks.'
evidence_quotes.value_days: No value days discussion; customer objected to pricing and withdrew before any flexibility conversation could occur.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep never asks for the business. Customer self-terminates: 'Of course. Thank you. Bye.' Rep responds: 'Okay. Alright then I'll send you an email. Thank you, bye-bye.'

top_strength: Rep successfully conducted a full virtual walkthrough inventory and gathered complete logistics details (room-by-room items, bed sizes, box estimates, garage contents, crew size and truck requirement).
coaching_note: Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) were never delivered during this walkthrough call—they must be given early, before probing starts, regardless of call type.
